checkpoint_lock.rule: full18 VAL only: feasible iff hard macro actual regret and unconditional fixed36 missed frequency <= separate saved R84A VAL references; among feasible maximize native Top1, then minimize actual regret, then earliest; if none feasible minimize sum of positive violations / max(reference,1e-12), then maximize native Top1, minimize actual regret, earliest

checkpoint_lock.winner_rule: native int64 ind from locked source cache, verified against original FP64 argmin; never FP32 argmin
